Definition
[CW complex]

\group CW Complexes

A cell complex or CW complex is built inductively as follows:

  1. $X^0$ is a discrete set of 0-cells.

  2. $X^n$ is obtained from $X^{n-1}$ by attaching disks $D^n_\alpha $ along maps $\varphi _\alpha :S^{n-1}\to X^{n-1}$. Thus $X^n=X^{n-1}\sqcup _\alpha e^n_\alpha $ as a set, where $e^n_\alpha $ is an open disk.

  3. The construction either stops at a finite stage $X=X^n$, or $X=\bigcup _nX^n$ with the weak topology: $B\subset X$ is open or closed exactly when $B\cap X^n$ has that property in every $X^n$.
